summary: Psychology graduate with a B.S. in Psychology and a background in customer-facing, high-pressure operational roles spanning mail carrier assistance, event ambassadorship, retail stock and sales, and cashiering. Brings analytic problem-solving, project coordination, and relationship-building strengths, with experience in crisis management, counseling-adjacent client support, and quality-driven productivity under tight deadlines. Proficient in Microsoft Office, SPSS for research data analysis, and point-of-sale and cash-handling systems. Best suited to entry-level or transitional roles in customer service, operations coordination, research support, or client-facing program work.
